findings.issue: The i18n spec asserts the hardcoded REQUIRED_KEYS list exists in BOTH uk.json and en.json (presence-in-both), which does satisfy the TDD anchor for the new funnels.*/errors.funnels.* keys. But it does NOT verify the two locales have IDENTICAL full key sets — it imports collectKeySet but never calls compareKeySets/checkLocales. A drift key present in only one locale outside the required list would pass this spec. Full-set parity is currently enforced only by scripts/check-locales.mjs (run manually / in CI), not by a Vitest spec.
findings.fix: Add one assertion using the existing compareKeySets/checkLocales export: e.g. `const { diff } = checkLocales(localesDir); expect(diff.missingInA).toEqual([]); expect(diff.missingInB).toEqual([])` so the deterministic full uk/en parity is guarded by the test suite itself, not only the standalone script. Non-blocking.

summary: All 10 TDD anchors are present, meaningfully asserted, and the suite passes (11/11, deterministic). Store specs verify real behavior: fetch populates funnels and asserts URL + query (omitted for 'all', {status:'active'} for filter) with loading transitions; create asserts POST body and returned id; the re-throw spec uses rejects.toMatchObject + error flag and CRUCIALLY mocks only useApi/useRoute (NOT useApiError) — proving the store does not depend on it; update asserts PATCH URL/method/body; delete asserts DELETE and list mutation to ['b']. Component specs correctly use the REAL useApiError (mocked only in store would be wrong; here it is not mocked at all in the component spec, exercising actual error mapping) and mock only the store + navigateTo: required-name blocks submit and does not call create; valid submit calls create with exact payload and navigates to /projects/p1/funnels/f99; server-error path asserts a non-empty mapped message that is not a raw 'errors.' key, no navigation, no 'created' emit. All assertions are strong (request URL/method/body, returned values, list mutation, navigation path) — no shallow toHaveBeenCalled-only or mock-return tautologies. i18n keys verified present in both locales. One low-severity gap: full uk/en set-equality is enforced by check-locales.mjs but not asserted in the spec. No regressions, no blockers.
